# Screenshot Planning — Flaky Test Detector

## Screenshots

### 1. Gutter Icons Next to Tests
- **Title:** "See Test Reliability in Your Editor"
- **What to capture:** A test class with @Test annotations and color-coded gutter icons showing stable (green), suspicious (yellow), and flaky (red) tests.

### 2. Flaky Tests Dashboard
- **Title:** "Full Test Reliability Overview"
- **What to capture:** The Flaky Tests tool window showing the sortable table with test names, flakiness scores, run counts, and sparkline graphs.

### 3. Sparkline Visualization
- **Title:** "Test Stability Patterns at a Glance"
- **What to capture:** Close-up of the dashboard focusing on the sparkline column showing different patterns (stable, intermittent, degrading).

### 4. Quarantine Mode
- **Title:** "Isolate Flaky Tests"
- **What to capture:** A test marked as quarantined with the quarantine badge and the context menu showing the quarantine/unquarantine options.

### 5. One-Click Rerun
- **Title:** "Rerun Suspicious Tests Instantly"
- **What to capture:** The dashboard with the rerun button highlighted and a test being re-executed.

### 6. Trend Charts (Pro)
- **Title:** "Track Flakiness Over Time"
- **What to capture:** The trend chart view showing flakiness score changes over days/weeks with improving and worsening trends visible.

### 7. Settings Panel
- **Title:** "Configurable Thresholds"
- **What to capture:** The plugin settings page showing threshold sliders for suspicious, flaky, and highly unstable categories.

### 8. Test History Detail
- **Title:** "Complete Test Execution History"
- **What to capture:** The detailed view of a single test showing its complete execution history with timestamps, results, and duration.

## Video Demo Outline (50 seconds)

| Time | Scene | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| 0-5s | Intro | Plugin name and tagline with a test class in background |
| 5-15s | Run tests | Execute a test suite, show results being recorded automatically |
| 15-25s | Gutter icons | Navigate to test class showing reliability icons next to each test |
| 25-35s | Dashboard | Open the Flaky Tests dashboard, sort by flakiness score |
| 35-45s | Quarantine | Demonstrate quarantining a flaky test and rerunning it |
| 45-50s | CTA | "Install from JetBrains Marketplace" with plugin URL |
